title: Sekhemas Baryas and Relics: Floors, Saved Runs and Relic Setup
summary: A family reference for the Trial of the Sekhemas key items: Balbala's Barya, Djinn Barya and the Test Baryas that save your run, plus Normal and Unique Relics placed in the Relic Altar before the trial starts.
description: A source-linked reference for Sekhemas Baryas and Relics in Path of Exile 2: the Barya family table, how Test Baryas save Sacred Water / Boons / Afflictions / Pacts, Relic Altar slots, and which Relic solves which problem.
author: Exile2 Guides Editorial Team
imageAlt: Sekhemas Baryas and Relics — the Trial of the Sekhemas key items and Relic Altar setup that save and continue a trial run

sections.title: Quick answer
sections.callout: A Barya is the key that starts or continues a Trial of the Sekhemas floor. Test Baryas save your current run — including the Sacred Water, Boons, Afflictions and Pacts shown on the tooltip — so you can resume or trade it later. Relics must be placed in the Relic Altar before the trial starts; once the run begins you cannot change them.
calloutDetail: Balbala's Barya (Act 2 quest) opens the first trial and is returned if you fail; Djinn Barya (drop / trade) opens repeatable runs whose floor count scales with item level.
The Relic Altar has 18 slots, 12 of which unlock by completing floors. The Barya is not consumed until you confirm the relics and start.

answers.label: Use for
text: Entering or continuing the Trial of the Sekhemas to earn ascendancy points and Unique Relics from Zarokh.

answers.label: Where
text: The Relic Altar at the Trial of the Sekhemas — insert the Barya and place Relics before confirming.

answers.label: Avoid
text: Swapping Relics after the run starts, or assuming the quest Barya is lost on failure — it is returned to you.

sections.title: The Barya family
intro: All Sekhemas key items are Baryas. The quest and Djinn Baryas start runs; the four Test Baryas are created by completing a floor and save that exact run so you can continue or trade it.

members.title: Balbala's Barya
body: Drops from Balbala, the Traitor in Act 2 Traitor's Passage. Opens the initial 1-floor trial and is returned to you if the run fails.

members.title: Djinn Barya
body: Random drop from Waystone (Tier 1+) maps and tradeable. Its item level sets how many floors the run contains (1 to 4) and whether it grants ascendancy points.

members.title: Test of Strength Barya
body: Obtained by completing the previous floor; saves the current run (Sacred Water, Boons, Afflictions, Pacts) and continues at Floor 1.

members.title: Test of Will Barya
body: Obtained by completing the Test of Strength floor; saves progress and continues at Floor 2.

members.title: Test of Cunning Barya
body: Obtained by completing the Test of Will floor; saves progress and continues at Floor 3.

members.title: Test of Time Barya
body: Obtained by completing the Test of Cunning floor; saves progress and continues into the Zarokh floor (Floor 4).

members.title: Normal Relics
body: Magic-rarity relics that drop anywhere in the trial. Placed in the Relic Altar before the run to grant beneficial modifiers; cannot be changed once the run starts.

members.title: Unique Relics
body: Drop from Zarokh, the Temporal. Each applies a challenge modifier to the run and grants a special reward on completion; destroyed when applied.

properties.label: Relic Altar slots
notes: 18 total; 12 unlock by completing trial floors.
The Djinn Barya is not consumed until you confirm the relics and start.

properties.label: Run resources
notes: Honour equals your Life + Energy Shield and ends the run at 0.
Sacred Water is a per-run currency spent at merchants and the Keth Forge.

properties.label: Progress saved by
notes: Test Baryas store Sacred Water, Boons, Afflictions and Pacts on the item.

sections.title: How to get Baryas and Relics
intro: Baryas and Relics come from different places depending on whether you are starting the trial or continuing a saved run.

routes.label: Balbala's Barya (quest)
body: Defeat Balbala, the Traitor in Act 2 Traitor's Passage; she drops the quest Barya that opens the first trial.

routes.label: Djinn Barya (drop / trade)
body: Djinn Barya drops from monsters in Waystone (Tier 1+) maps and is tradeable. Higher item level means more floors.

routes.label: Test Barya (continue)
body: Each Test Barya is created by completing the previous floor; it saves your current run so you can resume later or trade it.

routes.label: Relics (drop / merchant)
body: Normal relics drop anywhere in the trial (monsters, caches, urns); Unique relics drop from Zarokh. Buy more from Balbala the Merchant inside a run.

sections.title: How to use a Barya and Relics

steps.label: Insert the Barya
body: At the Trial of the Sekhemas, place a Balbala's / Djinn / Test Barya into the Relic Altar to start or resume a run.

steps.label: Place Relics first
body: Before confirming, place your Relics into the Relic Altar. Relics must be set before the run starts — you cannot change them once the run begins.

steps.label: Confirm and enter
body: The Djinn Barya is consumed only when you confirm the relics and start. Test Baryas resume the saved run.

steps.label: Progress the floors
body: Clear rooms and bosses floor by floor. On success of a floor you may receive the next Test Barya to continue, or finish the run.

steps.label: Unique Relic challenge (optional)
body: Apply a Unique Relic at the altar to convert the run into a harder challenge run with a special reward on completion.

sections.title: Barya and Relic timing
note: Barya types decide which floor you enter and whether the run is new or a saved continuation. Relics must be placed before the run starts.

items.fix: Use it to learn the mechanics.

entries.question: Why did Balbala's Barya disappear after I failed?
summary: Players think the quest Barya is consumed on failure.
editorialAnalysis: The quest Balbala's Barya is returned to the player if the challenge is failed, unlike a Djinn Barya which is consumed on entry. Failing the campaign trial does not cost the key.
officialAnswer: The quest Barya is returned on failure; a Djinn Barya is consumed on entry.

entries.kind: Wiki — can I buy a saved Barya?
entries.question: Can I buy someone's Barya saved to floor 4?
summary: Players ask whether saved Test Baryas are tradeable.
editorialAnalysis: Test Baryas save the current run and are tradeable, so you can buy a Barya already progressed to a later floor. Verify the saved floor and Sacred Water before purchasing.
officialAnswer: Test Baryas are tradeable and preserve saved progress (Sacred Water, Boons, Afflictions, Pacts).

entries.question: Why is the Relic Altar locked after I start?
summary: Players expect to swap Relics mid-run.
editorialAnalysis: Once the run starts the altar is inaccessible until the run is completed, failed, or forfeited. Relic bonuses are visible bottom-left of the trial map but cannot be changed.
officialAnswer: Relics are locked once the run begins; place them before confirming.
